I've reviewed the transcript, the answer key, and all 18 record items. Here is my grading.

**Pairings and checks**

- **e1** → record 2 (carries the trust, successor trustee, the four properties with the $265k/$410k/$198k/$176k split totalling $1,049,000, and the step-up). Record 1 states only the death date, so it is the split-off half of the same key item.
- **e2** → record 5; Nov 10, 2026, six weeks, back in January all match.
- **a1/a2/a3** → records 9, 11, 10; $68,400, $43,400 and $25,000 all match the corrected figures (the meeting's initial $86,000 was corrected at [00:21:46]).
- **i1–i7** → records 12, 16, 13, 14, 15, 18, 17. Owners and dates all match the final versions: Imani (not Anneliese) on the umbrella by Sept 29, Gavin on the listing by Oct 2 (moved from Sept 18), Imani tomorrow Sept 16, Celeste before the Dec 8 meeting and the week of Sept 28.

**Not-actions** — none of the five leaked into the action lists. The Maren condo idea appears only as a life event explicitly flagged "no action, nothing to model," which is correct handling; the duplex sale, 1031, LLC and proceeds-investment questions are absent from both action lists.

**Extras** — record 1 is a split of e1; records 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 are all established by the transcript, with correct figures ($68,400 and ~$9,000 deposits; $400/month and Oct 31; $425,000 list, $19,000 roof bid — not the misspoken $90,000 — and $375–380k net against $410,000 basis; $176,000 basis).

key_items.note: Record 2 carries the substance of e1: revocable trust, Gavin as successor trustee, all four Dayton-area rentals with the date-of-death appraisals ($265,000 / $410,000 / $198,000 / $176,000 = $1,049,000) and the stepped-up basis. All figures match the transcript at [00:04:29]-[00:05:03]. Record 1 supplies only the Feb 11, 2026 death date and is treated as the split-off half.
Right knee replacement Nov 10, 2026, about six weeks out, back in January - matches [00:28:27]-[00:28:41] exactly.
ACH of the full $68,400 from joint checking into the joint brokerage account. Uses the corrected figure, not the misspoken $86,000.
$43,400 into the moderate model in the joint brokerage account - matches Celeste's restated plan at [00:22:17] and the recap at [00:30:21].

Second joint cash-only money market account as the property reserve funded with $25,000, excluded from model rebalancing. Figure and structure correct; the $25,000 survived the 86,000-to-68,400 correction unchanged.

Full appraisal reports (land/building split) plus Denise's ledger since February to Rick Dunleavy, copying Celeste. Owner Gavin correct; due end of next week = Friday, Sept 25, 2026, correct. No figures.

$2 million umbrella with rentals scheduled plus landlord policies on the two kept properties through the P&C partner. Owner correctly reassigned from Anneliese to Imani at [00:28:47]; due the 29th (Tuesday, Sept 29, 2026) correct.

Walk the fourplex with Tamsin then sign the listing agreement as trustee covering both properties. Owner Gavin correct; due captures the change from Friday Sept 18 to Friday, Oct 2, 2026 per [00:27:50]-[00:28:11].
Interview at least two of Tamsin's three names, pick one for the duplex and Cotswold before Denise stops. Owner Gavin correct; end of October 2026 correct, with Oct 31 noted accurately.
ACH authorization and new account application out for e-signature. Owner Imani correct; due tomorrow = Wednesday, Sept 16, 2026, correct relative to the Sept 15 meeting.

Rerun projection with retirement at 60, about $20,000/year net from the two kept rentals, proceeds as a range. Both figures match [00:19:36] and [00:29:27]. Owner Celeste correct; due before the Dec 8, 2026 meeting correct (the Dec 3 date was rejected by Gavin).

Joint call with Rick Dunleavy and Hollis on seller identity, whose return the fourplex loss lands on, and the Q4 estimated payment. Owner Celeste correct; week of Sept 28, 2026 once Rick has the appraisals, correct.

extra_items.note: Splits key item e1: the death on Feb 11, 2026 is the opening clause of the same life event captured by record 2, which carries the inheritance, trust and step-up detail. Accurate but not an independent event.

Transcript establishes the August trust distribution of accumulated rent plus the mother's savings account, sitting in joint checking. Uses the corrected $68,400 and flags the initial $86,000 as corrected, and the roughly $9,000 of security deposits staying in the trust account matches [00:06:55].

Denise managing since February for $400/month and finishing at the end of October 2026 is stated at [00:18:37]. Correct as background to the property-manager action item rather than a restatement of it.
Correctly recorded as a life-event note, not an action. Mirrors Celeste's handling at [00:26:33]: someday idea, no amount, no action, nothing to model yet. This is the right place for n1.

The sell decision on the Larchmere fourplex is firmly agreed at [00:13:37]-[00:13:51]. Figures check out: $425,000 list, $19,000 roof bid (the $90,000 was immediately corrected to nineteen), $375,000-$380,000 net against the $410,000 stepped-up basis. Distinct from action item 13, which is the signing task.
Sell Pennyroyal Court once the tenant leaves Oct 31, rather than re-renting, agreed at [00:14:16]-[00:14:52]. Stepped-up basis $176,000 and the near tax non-event framing both match.
